user.title: Connect Yandex SpeechKit
user.description: Enter a Yandex Cloud service-account API key with ai.speechkit-stt.user and ai.speechkit-tts.user roles. Saving sends a short test phrase to Yandex SpeechKit to check the key and TTS access. Speech audio and text are sent to Yandex Cloud when this provider is selected; service usage may be billed. The key is stored in this Home Assistant installation.

error.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid or lacks access to SpeechKit.
error.quota: Yandex SpeechKit reported a quota or billing limit.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Yandex SpeechKit.
error.timeout: The Yandex SpeechKit check timed out.
error.invalid_request: Yandex SpeechKit rejected the check request.
error.invalid_response: Yandex SpeechKit returned an unexpected response.
